Location

  • CURIE: gmeow:Location
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Location
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

A locus where an entity can be situated, reside, or occur — a geographic place, an online (virtual) location, a digital storage location, or an astronomical/celestial position.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Entity, gufo:Object

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Location as a specialized kind of gmeow:Entity, gufo:Object. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Entity

Equivalent or closely aligned targets: bfo, crm
